temperature_scale: Temperature gauge range: 0–100 °C; this is not the hardware's critical temperature.
frequency_scale: Frequency gauge range: 0–%.2f GHz, using the maximum reported by Noctalia.
frequency_scale_missing: No frequency ceiling is available; the current value is shown without a filled arc.
cpu_usage_hint: All logical cores combined. User and system activity use separate ring segments.
settings.additional_interfaces_help: Exact interface names. Empty shows only the monitored interface. Rates are never added together.
settings.public_ip_help: Queries ipify over HTTPS while the network popup is open, at most once per minute. Shows the default route's public address.
memory_breakdown_hint: The used-memory ring partitions anonymous pages, shared memory, known unreclaimable kernel allocations and remaining used memory. Available memory is the gray remainder. Cache and Zswap details may overlap these groups and are not added again.
memory_breakdown_unavailable: This snapshot cannot be split into additive memory groups.
public_ip_hint: Address reported by the external lookup service for the default route. It does not represent every selected interface.
settings.magpie_endpoint_help: VictoriaMetrics query base URL downstream of the OTLP collector.
magpie.input_help: Input includes cache reads and writes; these OTLP metrics do not separate cache tokens.
magpie.calls_help: Model attempts, including retries and failures; parent request spans are excluded.
magpie.empty: No Magpie metrics in this window
magpie.title: Magpie
psi_hint: PSI some is the percentage of time in which at least one task was stalled on this resource. It is not a macOS pressure level.
psi_unavailable: Pressure information is unavailable on this system.
memory_hint: Used = total − available. Detail fields overlap and must not be added together.
cpu_process_hint: CPU is measured over the last interval; one logical core = 100%.
rss_hint: Ranked by resident memory (RSS). Shared pages may be counted in several processes.
io_hint: Storage bytes attributed to readable processes; buffered writes and kernel writeback may differ from device activity.
disk_scope_hint: The chart follows the selected block device. Filesystem capacities are listed separately; layered devices are never summed.
network_scope_hint: The chart follows the selected interface (default: IPv4 default route, then first available interface). Interfaces are never summed.
process_warming: Collecting two process snapshots for interval usage…
history_warming: Waiting for enough samples to draw history…
status.disabled: Enable Noctalia's system monitor to collect metrics.
status.stale: Samples are out of date. Check the plugin service.
status.error: Collection failed. Check Noctalia's plugin log.
status.inactive: Open a resource panel to collect process details.
status.missing_dependency: Collector unavailable. Build the binary or select it in plugin settings.
settings.disk_device_help: Kernel device name, such as nvme0n1 or dm-0. Empty selects the first whole device in name order.
settings.interface_help: Monitored interface name. Empty follows the IPv4 default route, then the first interface in name order.
